blogPosts.title: What Does a Roadworthy Inspection Involve in Victoria?
blogPosts.excerpt: Understanding the RWC process for Mitcham vehicles, including key checks and common issues to pass smoothly.

Key areas checked during an RWC include the braking system, steering and suspension, tyres, lights, and body condition. blogPosts.title: Tyre Maintenance Tips for Melbourne's East
blogPosts.excerpt: Keep your tyres in top condition with advice specific to Mitcham and surrounding suburbs for safety and efficiency.
body: In Melbourne's eastern suburbs like Mitcham, proper tyre maintenance is vital due to diverse road conditions, from busy arterials to hilly residential areas. Tyres are your car's only contact with the road, so regular checks prevent accidents and improve fuel economy. At Rapid Tune Mitcham, we recommend inspecting tyres monthly for tread depth, pressure, and damage. Given Mitcham's climate, with hot summers that can affect tyre pressure, staying vigilant ensures optimal performance.

Tread depth is a critical safety factor; in Victoria, the legal minimum is 1.6mm. For Mitcham drivers, especially those commuting on the Eastern Freeway, deeper tread provides better grip in wet conditions. We suggest using the '20-cent coin test'—if tread doesn't cover the coin's outer rim, it's time for replacement. Worn tyres increase stopping distances, which is risky in Mitcham's school zones or busy intersections. Regular rotations every 10,000 km help even out wear.

Tyre pressure should match the manufacturer's specifications, found in the door jamb or manual. In Mitcham, temperature fluctuations can cause pressure changes; under-inflation leads to poor fuel efficiency and uneven wear. We use digital gauges for accurate checks. For electric vehicles becoming common in Mitcham, proper inflation is even more critical due to heavier batteries. Over-inflation reduces traction, so balance is key for handling Mitcham's winding roads.

Punctures and damage are frequent issues in Mitcham, where roads may have debris or potholes. Regular visual inspections can catch cuts, bulges, or embedded objects early. If you hit a kerb in Mitcham's tight parking areas, get an alignment check to prevent tyre damage. We offer mobile services for Mitcham residents, providing convenience for busy schedules. Promptly addressing minor issues avoids blowouts, especially on high-speed roads like the freeway.

Wheel alignment and balancing are essential for tyre longevity. Misalignment causes uneven wear, often seen on the inner or outer edges. In Mitcham, where road surfaces vary, alignment checks after any impact are wise. We use computerised systems for precision, ensuring even tread wear. Balanced wheels reduce vibration, enhancing comfort on Mitcham's longer commutes. This maintenance not only extends tyre life but also improves vehicle handling and safety.

For daily commuting in wet or dry weather, quality tyres from reputable brands are a worthwhile investment. We stock tyres suitable for Mitcham's needs and offer competitive pricing.
